title_zh: 乙型肝炎相关性肝硬化患者并发慢性门静脉血栓形成的感染性门静脉炎:病例报告 和文献综述
source_body_en: Abstract Background Infective pylephlebitis is suppurative thrombophlebitis of the portal venous system. It is rare, lethal when recognition is delayed, and almost always described in patients without pre-existing portal vein thrombosis (PVT). In cirrhosis with chronic PVT, anticoagulation is constrained by varices and coagulopathy, and no guidance covers the infected thrombus. Case presentation: A 68-year-old Han Chinese man with hepatitis B-related decompensated cirrhosis, previous variceal bleeding treated by splenectomy, and chronic PVT maintained on low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) for 5 years presented with fever, abdominal pain and back distension. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) showed occlusion of the main portal vein and superior mesenteric vein, periportal collaterals and right colonic mural oedema; blood culture grew non-O1/non-O139 Vibrio cholerae . Continuous intravenous unfractionated heparin (UFH) targeting an activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT) of 50–70 s was started together with cefoperazone/sulbactam. On day 3 the patient declined the infusion pump and was changed to subcutaneous LMWH. On day 5 the pain worsened, the APTT fell to 31.3 s, the D-dimer rose from 2.07 to 18.74 mg/L and CT showed thrombus extending into the collateral vessels. Continuous UFH was resumed after multidisciplinary review. Over the next two weeks the fever and abdominal pain resolved and the diarrhoea improved; C-reactive protein fell from 20.14 to 0.79 mg/L, and the portal vein was patent on day 12 and fully patent by day 31. Ascites that had persisted for years and diarrhoea present for 5 years resolved completely. Conclusions Chronic PVT does not protect against superimposed infective pylephlebitis, and bloodstream infection can convert a stable thrombus into a propagating one within days. High fever, worsening abdominal or back pain and an abrupt rise in D-dimer should prompt immediate contrast-enhanced CT. Once the diagnosis is established, culture-directed antimicrobials combined with continuous intravenous heparinization, titrated to APTT and interrupted when bleeding risk rises, can achieve recanalization despite previous variceal haemorrhage. Clinical improvement lags behind thrombus resolution, and a high D-dimer in the first week is not a reason to stop heparin.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 感染性门静脉炎是门静脉系统的化脓性血栓性静脉炎。当识别延迟时,这种情况很少见,是致命的,并且几乎总是在没有预先存在门静脉血栓 (PVT) 的患者中发生。对于伴有慢性门静脉血栓的肝硬化,抗凝治疗受到静脉曲张和凝血病的限制,并且没有针对感染血栓的指导。病例介绍:一名 68 岁汉族男性,患有乙型肝炎相关失代偿性肝硬化,既往因脾切除治疗静脉曲张出血,慢性 PVT 维持低分子肝素 (LMWH) 5 年,出现发热、腹痛和背胀。增强计算机断层扫描 (CT) 显示门静脉主干和肠系膜上静脉闭塞、门静脉周围循环和右结肠壁水肿;血培养培养出非 O1/非 O139 霍乱弧菌。连续静脉注射普通肝素 (UFH) 与头孢哌酮/舒巴坦一起开始,目标活化部分凝血活酶时间 (APTT) 为 50-70 秒。第 3 天,患者拒绝使用输液泵,改用皮下 LMWH。第5天疼痛加剧,APTT降至31.3秒,D-二聚体从2.07毫克/升升至18.74毫克/升,CT显示血栓延伸至侧支血管。经过多学科审查后,恢复持续和睦家医疗。在接下来的两周内,发烧和腹痛消失,腹泻也得到改善。C反应蛋白从20.14毫克/升下降到0.79毫克/升,门静脉在第12天通畅,到第31天完全通畅。持续多年的腹水和持续5年的腹泻完全解决。结论 慢性PVT不能预防叠加感染性门静脉炎,血流感染可以在几天内将稳定的血栓转变为传播的血栓。高烧、腹部或背部疼痛加剧以及 D-二聚体突然升高应立即进行对比增强 CT 检查。一旦 诊断 建立,培养导向的抗菌药物与持续静脉内肝素化相结合,滴定至 APTT 并在出血风险上升时中断,尽管既往有静脉曲张出血,仍可实现血管再通。临床改善滞后于血栓消退,第一周的高 D-二聚体并不是停止使用肝素的理由。

title: Anti-Viral Treatment Eligibility and Treatment Uptake Among People With Chronic Hepatitis B in Australia: The REACH-B Study.
abstract: Treatment indication for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) varies across clinical guidelines. This study evaluated treatment eligibility and uptake in a large Australian cohort of people with CHB. The REACH-B study recruited people with CHB managed through a national network of healthcare services. Participants were categorised into three groups: (1) receiving antiviral therapy; (2) untreated despite eligibility; (3) untreated and ineligible. Treatment eligibility was determined using Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) criteria, and by international clinical guidelines. Among 3648 participants (56% male; median age 48 years; 49% born in North-East or South-East Asia; 27% First Nations Australians), 14% were HBeAg positive and 7% had cirrhosis. Overall, 47% (n = 1666) were on antiviral therapy, 45% (n = 1573) were untreated and ineligible and 7% (n = 251) were untreated despite eligibility based on Australian PBS criteria. In adjusted analysis, the likelihood of remaining untreated despite eligibility was higher among women (aOR 1.59, 95% CI 1.34, 1.88) and younger participants (age 41-60 vs. > 60 years: aOR 1.51, 95% CI 1.01-2.28; ≤ 40 vs. > 60 years: aOR 2.65, 95% CI 1.60, 4.40). The proportion untreated despite eligibility increased to 13% when applying 2024 World Health Organisation guidelines and ranged 2%-44% based on other guidelines, highlighting the variability across the guidelines. In conclusion, among REACH-B participants, most eligible individuals receive treatment. Lower treatment uptake among women and younger people despite eligibility partly reflects lower threshold for elevated ALT in women, and clinician determination of non-CHB related ALT elevation. As treatment guidelines evolve and eligibility criteria broaden, monitoring treatment patterns is important.

title: Discovery of XT1061, a HBV Capsid Assembly Modulator, as a Promising Therapeutic Candidate for Clinical Treatment of HBV Infection.
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) persists as a major unresolved infectious disease. Patients typically require lifelong administration of nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) or interferons but seldom achieve functional cure. Recent studies indicate that HBV core assembly modulators (CAMs), when combined with NAs and interferons, can more effectively reduce HBsAg in plasma, thereby facilitating functional cure. In this research, we discovered compound 39 (designated XT1061) through structural optimization of previously reported GLP-26, which exhibited potent anti-HBV activity in vitro (EC50 = 1.0 ± 0.1 nM). In the murine AAV/HBV model, XT1061 induced rapid reduction of HBV DNA and sustained viral DNA clearance throughout treatment. Notably, Combination therapy of XT1061 with pradefovir mesylate (PDV) exhibited significantly enhanced efficacy compared with monotherapy. Further preclinical evaluation and Phase I clinical trials (NCT06280534) confirmed that XT1061 possesses favorable drug-like properties and low safety risks. Collectively, XT1061 represents a promising anti-HBV therapeutic candidate, providing a viable strategy for the clinical management of chronic HBV infection.

title_zh: 发现 XT1061(一种 HBV 衣壳组装调节剂)作为 HBV 感染临床 治疗 的有前景的治疗候选药物。
source_body_en: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) persists as a major unresolved infectious disease. Patients typically require lifelong administration of nucleos(t)ide analogs (NAs) or interferons but seldom achieve functional cure. Recent studies indicate that HBV core assembly modulators (CAMs), when combined with NAs and interferons, can more effectively reduce HBsAg in plasma, thereby facilitating functional cure. In this research, we discovered compound 39 (designated XT1061) through structural optimization of previously reported GLP-26, which exhibited potent anti-HBV activity in vitro (EC50 = 1.0 ± 0.1 nM). In the murine AAV/HBV model, XT1061 induced rapid reduction of HBV DNA and sustained viral DNA clearance throughout treatment. Notably, Combination therapy of XT1061 with pradefovir mesylate (PDV) exhibited significantly enhanced efficacy compared with monotherapy. Further preclinical evaluation and Phase I clinical trials (NCT06280534) confirmed that XT1061 possesses favorable drug-like properties and low safety risks. Collectively, XT1061 represents a promising anti-HBV therapeutic candidate, providing a viable strategy for the clinical management of chronic HBV infection.

title: Awareness of Hepatitis B Virus and Preventive Behaviour among Literate Adults: A Comparative Cross-Sectional Study of Brazil and Peru
abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains one of the leading causes of liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma worldwide, with an estimated 254 million people living with chronic infection and approximately 1.1 million deaths annually (World Health Organization, 2024). In Latin America, awareness of the disease remains suboptimal, with a persistent gap between the availability of free screening and vaccination services within public health systems and the actual uptake of these services (Bittencourt et al., 2023). Objective: This study aimed to measure the level of awareness of hepatitis B virus among literate adults in Brazil and Peru, to compare the two countries in terms of overall awareness, knowledge of transmission routes, and vaccine literacy, and to examine the effects of gender, educational attainment, religious affiliation, and information sources on awareness scores. Methods: A comparative cross-sectional survey design was employed. The sample comprised 783 participants from each country (total N = 1,566), selected through proportional multistage stratified sampling from urban areas in Brazil (São Paulo and Bahia states) and Peru (Lima and Cusco regions). A uniform trilingual instrument—the Hepatitis B Awareness Questionnaire–Cross-Cultural Version (HBAQ-CC)—consisting of 34 items on a five-point Likert scale was administered following validity testing (five-expert review and back-translation) and reliability testing (Cronbach's alpha ≥ 0.70 in both countries). Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, independent-samples t-tests, one-way and two-way analysis of variance, chi-square tests, and logistic regression at a 0.05 significance level.
journal: International Journal of Advanced Humanities Research

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a significant global health issue, with high prevalence and mortality rates. The study aimed to address the knowledge gap regarding awareness of HBV among literate adults in Brazil and Peru.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A comparative cross-sectional survey design was employed, with a sample of 783 participants from each country (total N = 1,566), selected through proportional multistage stratified sampling from urban areas in Brazil (São Paulo and Bahia states) and Peru (Lima and Cusco regions).
analysis.methods: A uniform trilingual instrument—the Hepatitis B Awareness Questionnaire–Cross-Cultural Version (HBAQ-CC)—was used, consisting of 34 items on a five-point Likert scale. The questionnaire was validated through five-expert review and back-translation, and its reliability was confirmed with Cronbach's alpha ≥ 0.70 in both countries. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, independent-samples t-tests, one-way and two-way analysis of variance, chi-square tests, and logistic regression at a 0.05 significance level.
analysis.main_results: The study directly observed the level of awareness of HBV among literate adults in Brazil and Peru, with specific statistical analyses conducted to compare awareness scores across demographic and informational factors.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as highlighting the need for targeted public health interventions to improve HBV awareness, particularly in regions where uptake of free screening and vaccination services remains low.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies to enhance HBV awareness and improve the uptake of screening and vaccination services in Latin American countries.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which does not allow for causal inferences, and its focus on urban populations, which may limit generalisability. The evidence strength is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the awareness of hepatitis B virus (HBV) among literate adults in Brazil and Peru, aiming to compare awareness levels, knowledge of transmission routes, and vaccine literacy between the two countries. Using a comparative cross-sectional survey design, data were collected from 783 participants in each country through a validated trilingual questionnaire. The study found that awareness levels varied between the countries and was influenced by factors such as gender, educational attainment, and information sources. The authors interpreted these findings as indicating a need for improved public health interventions to increase HBV awareness and uptake of screening and vaccination services. The study's limitations include its cross-sectional nature and focus on urban populations, which may affect generalisability. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these constraints.

title_zh: 识字成人的 乙型肝炎病毒 意识和预防行为:巴西和秘鲁的比较横断面研究
source_body_en: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains one of the leading causes of liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma worldwide, with an estimated 254 million people living with chronic infection and approximately 1.1 million deaths annually (World Health Organization, 2024). In Latin America, awareness of the disease remains suboptimal, with a persistent gap between the availability of free screening and vaccination services within public health systems and the actual uptake of these services (Bittencourt et al., 2023). Objective: This study aimed to measure the level of awareness of hepatitis B virus among literate adults in Brazil and Peru, to compare the two countries in terms of overall awareness, knowledge of transmission routes, and vaccine literacy, and to examine the effects of gender, educational attainment, religious affiliation, and information sources on awareness scores. Methods: A comparative cross-sectional survey design was employed. The sample comprised 783 participants from each country (total N = 1,566), selected through proportional multistage stratified sampling from urban areas in Brazil (São Paulo and Bahia states) and Peru (Lima and Cusco regions). A uniform trilingual instrument—the Hepatitis B Awareness Questionnaire–Cross-Cultural Version (HBAQ-CC)—consisting of 34 items on a five-point Likert scale was administered following validity testing (five-expert review and back-translation) and reliability testing (Cronbach's alpha ≥ 0.70 in both countries). Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, independent-samples t-tests, one-way and two-way analysis of variance, chi-square tests, and logistic regression at a 0.05 significance level.

title: Computational design of a mutation-inclusive multi-epitope vaccine targeting major immune-escape variants of hepatitis B surface antigen
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major global health burden, responsible for the deaths of millions annually due to chronic liver complications. Currently, the emergence of immune-escape mutations within the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), particularly within the “a” determinant region, continues to pose a challenge to the effectiveness of existing vaccines. Therefore, this study employed an in silico immunoinformatics approach to design a mutation-inclusive multi-epitope vaccine targeting globally circulating HBV variants at the “a” determinant region. The study was conducted through a structured ten-step immunoinformatics pipeline, comprising: antigen sequence retrieval, consensus sequence identification, prediction of cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL), helper T lymphocyte (HTL), and B-cell epitopes, multi-epitope vaccine construction, structural prediction and validation, assessment of physicochemical and immunological properties, molecular docking with immune receptors, immune response simulation, and codon optimization followed by in silico cloning. A total of 78 HBV surface protein sequences were retrieved from the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) database and analyzed using multiple sequence alignment to identify a consensus sequence. Following consensus sequence identification, epitopes were predicted and selected based on their binding affinity to major histocompatibility complex (MHC) molecules. The selected epitopes showed an estimated global population coverage of 99.55% and were assembled with adjuvant and linkers to construct a 939-amino-acid multi-epitope vaccine (MEV). Structural modeling of the MEV using AlphaFold3 revealed a stable globular-flexible hybrid architecture. The model was further refined using the Galaxy Web server and exhibited 97.01% of residues in favored Ramachandran regions and a MolProbity score of 1.22. Molecular docking predicted favorable interaction with Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), with an HDOCK score of − 323.89 and a ClusPro energy score of − 1715.4 kcal/mol, alongside predicted interactions with major histocompatibility complex class II (MHC-II) and Toll-like receptor 2 (TLR2) receptors. Computational immune simulations predicted Th1-skewed and humoral immune responses, including increased immunoglobulin production, cytokine activation, and sustained immune memory development. Codon optimization achieved a codon adaptation index (CAI) of 1.0 and a GC content of 66.67%. In silico cloning further indicated the theoretical feasibility of expressing the construct in an Escherichia coli expression system. The designed multi-epitope vaccine construct demonstrated favorable predicted structural characteristics, computationally assessed safety-related properties, and broad estimated population coverage. These findings support further investigation of the construct as a candidate targeting HBV immune-escape variants. Experimental validation in vitro and in vivo is required to establish its immunogenicity, safety, and protective efficacy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 仍然是全球主要的健康负担,每年导致数百万人因慢性肝脏并发症死​​亡。目前,乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)内,特别是“a”决定簇区域内免疫逃逸突变的出现,继续对现有疫苗的有效性构成挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用计算机免疫信息学方法设计了包含 突变 的多表位 疫苗,针对全球循环的 HBV 变异体的“a”决定簇区域。从国家生物技术信息中心 (NCBI) 数据库中检索了总共 78 个 HBV 表面蛋白序列,并使用多重序列比对进行分析,以确定共有序列。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究通过结构化的十步免疫信息学流程进行,包括:抗原序列检索、共有序列识别、细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞 (CTL)、辅助 T 淋巴细胞 (HTL) 和 B 细胞表位预测、多表位 疫苗 构建、结构预测和验证、理化和免疫特性评估、与免疫受体的分子对接、免疫应答 模拟和密码子优化,然后进行计算机模拟克隆。该模型使用 Galaxy Web 服务器进一步完善,在拉马钱德兰 (Ramachandran) 青睐的地区显示出 97.01% 的残留物,MolProbity 得分为 1.22。
elements_zh.main_results: 所选表位的估计全球群体覆盖率为 99.55%,并与佐剂和接头组装以构建 939 个氨基酸的多表位 疫苗 (MEV)。使用 AlphaFold3 对 MEV 进行结构建模揭示了稳定的球状-柔性混合架构。计算免疫模拟预测了 Th1 偏向和体液 免疫应答,包括免疫球蛋白产生增加、细胞因子激活和持续免疫记忆发展。设计的多表位 疫苗 构建体表现出良好的预测结构特征、计算评估的安全相关特性以及广泛的估计人群覆盖范围。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,设计的 疫苗 构建体可能会引发针对 HBV 免疫逃逸变异的广泛 免疫应答。这些发现支持进一步研究该构建体作为针对 HBV 免疫逃逸变体的候选者。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为 疫苗 的开发奠定了基础,该药物可以解决 HBV 中免疫逃逸 突变 的挑战,有可能改善全球 疫苗接种 策略并减轻与 HBV 感染相关的慢性肝脏并发症的负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于计算模型,不包括实验验证,这限制了对 疫苗 免疫原性、安全性和保护功效的信心。证据是温和的,因为它依赖于计算机预测,而没有体外或体内测试。

title: Prevalence of hepatitis delta virus (HDV) among hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive blood donors followed at the Blood Donor Medical Follow-up Centre (CMSDS) in Cte dIvoire
abstract: Chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) infection exacerbates hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related liver disease. In Côte d’Ivoire, HDV is systematic not systematically screened among hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive blood donors, and most regional estimates rely on anti-HDV serology, which indicates exposure but not active replication. This study aimed to determine HDV RNA replication positivity among HBsAg-positive blood donors followed at the Blood Donor Medical Follow-up Centre (CMSDS) of the National Blood Transfusion Centre of Côte d’Ivoire (CNTSCI), using nested reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). A cross-sectional study based on a non-probability convenience sample was conducted in March 2021. HDV RNA was detected by nested RT-PCR targeting two genomic regions (nucleotides 888–1122 and 313–485). Of 51 donors included, 75% were male (n = 38) and and mean age was 37 ± 9 years. HBV DNA results were available for 43 donors (84%). Among them, HDV RNA positivity was 88.9% (32/36) in those with detectable HBV viraemia and 100% (7/7) in those with undetectable viral load, giving an overall positivity 90.7% (39/43). This figure applies only to donors with available viral load data not the entire cohort of 51 donors. HDV RNA was also detected in donors receiving tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) with suppressed HBV viraemia. Given the convenience sample of donors already in follow-up care, findings are hypothesis-generating rather than population-level estimates. These results support larger representative studies and systematic HDV screening during follow-up of individuals with chronic HBV infection.
journal: International Journal of Genetics and Molecular Biology

title: Hepatitis B and C Elimination
abstract: In 2016, the World Health Organization set goals to eliminate the hepatitis C virus (HCV) as a public health threat by 2030; these include a 90% reduction in new infections, a 65% reduction in HCV-related mortality, the diagnosis of 90% of infected individuals, and the treatment of 80% of those eligible. Although direct-acting antivirals (DAAs) make a viral cure technically achievable, progress in Latin America remains heterogeneous. In this structured narrative review and country-level policy mapping, we assess the current epidemiology of HCV, screening and diagnostic pathways, care models, access to DAAs, national guidelines, and surveillance capabilities in select Latin American countries. While formal elimination commitments are becoming more common, universal or expanded screening, reflex diagnostic pathways, decentralized care, and integrated longitudinal registries remain unevenly implemented. Persistent deficiencies are particularly relevant for people who inject drugs (PWID), incarcerated populations, migrants, and other groups with barriers to conventional care. International experience supports point-of-care and reflex testing, prison-based testing and treatment, harm reduction integration, and decentralization as strategies to close these gaps. After achieving a sustained virological response, elimination programs must also address residual fibrosis, hepatocellular carcinoma risk, metabolic and alcohol-related liver injury, and the risk of HCV reinfection in populations that remain exposed to the virus.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查是结构化叙述性审查和国家级政策规划。它不报告特定的数据库、搜索日期或资格标准。这些方法涉及评估乙肝消除计划的现状,包括其在不同人群和地区的实施情况和有效性。

abstract_zh: 2016年,世界卫生组织设定了到2030年消除丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)这一公共卫生威胁的目标;其中包括新感染人数减少 90%、HCV 相关 死亡率 减少 65%、90% 感染者的 诊断 以及 80% 符合资格者的 治疗 减少。尽管直接作用的 抗病毒药物 (DAA) 在技术上可以实现病毒治疗,但拉丁美洲的进展仍然参差不齐。在这篇结构化叙述性审查和国家级政策规划中,我们评估了选定拉丁美洲国家目前的 HCV 流行病学、筛查和诊断途径、护理模式、DAA 获取、国家指南和 监测 能力。虽然正式消除承诺变得越来越普遍,但普遍或扩大筛查、反射诊断途径、分散护理和综合纵向登记的实施情况仍然不平衡。持续存在的缺陷与注射吸毒者(PWID)、被监禁人群、移民和其他难以获得常规护理的群体尤其相关。国际经验支持将现场护理和反射测试、监狱测试和 治疗、减少伤害整合和权力下放作为缩小这些差距的策略。在实现持续的病毒学反应后,消除计划还必须解决残留纤维化、肝细胞癌风险、代谢性和酒精相关的肝损伤,以及仍然暴露于病毒的人群中丙型肝炎病毒再感染的风险。

title: Low public awareness of hepatocellular carcinoma risk factors.
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevention can be mediated through hepatitis B virus (HBV) vaccination, hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment, and alcohol control. We assessed public awareness of their carcinogenic risks and association with digital information seeking behaviors. METHODS: We analyzed the nationally representative 2024 Health Information National Trends Survey (HINTS 7), including 6,711, 6,661, and 6,793 respondents with observed HBV, HCV, and alcohol awareness outcomes, respectively. Survey-weighted logistic regression with multiple imputation of missing covariates assessed associations with sociodemographic characteristics and digital behaviors. RESULTS: Overall awareness was low: only 18.0%, 16.7%, and 37.1% recognized HBV, HCV, and alcohol as carcinogenic, respectively. Older age was independently associated with lower alcohol-related awareness; compared with adults aged 18-34 years, those aged 35-49 years (aOR 0.67, 95% CI 0.48-0.93), 50-64 years (aOR 0.56, 95% CI 0.40-0.78), and ≥65 years (aOR 0.49, 95% CI 0.36-0.68) had lower awareness. Higher educational attainment was associated with greater alcohol-related awareness (aOR 1.86, 95% CI 1.47-2.34). Online health information seeking was associated with greater awareness of HCV-related (aOR 1.74, 95% CI 1.17-2.59) and alcohol-related cancer risk (aOR 1.95, 95% CI 1.44-2.63), but not HBV-related cancer risk (aOR 1.40, 95% CI 0.95-2.08). However, social media use was not independently associated with risk awareness in multivariable models. CONCLUSIONS: Public awareness of HCC risk factors remains low. General social media use was not independently associated with cancer-risk awareness, whereas online health information seeking was associated with greater HCV- and alcohol-related awareness. These findings highlight opportunities for more targeted, literacy-sensitive HCC-prevention communication. IMPACT AND IMPLICATIONS: Public awareness that hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C virus, and alcohol consumption are associated with cancer risk remains low among U.S. Using nationally representative HINTS 7 data, we identified sociodemographic differences in awareness and found that general social media use was not independently associated with awareness after multivariable adjustment, whereas online health information seeking was associated with greater awareness of HCV- and alcohol-related cancer risk. These findings highlight opportunities for targeted, literacy-sensitive communication strategies that facilitate access to credible health information and strengthen HCC prevention efforts.

title: Expert consensus on the management of hematologic adverse reactions related to pegylated interferon-alpha therapy for chronic hepatitis B
abstract: Abstract To assist clinicians in making rational decisions regarding the management of hematologic adverse reactions during pegylated interferon-alpha (PEG-IFN-α) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB), the National Medical Center for Infectious Diseases organized a panel of experts in infectious diseases, hepatology, hematology, and clinical pharmacy to develop this consensus based on current evidence and clinical practice. The consensus systematically describes the incidence, clinical characteristics, and mechanisms of neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and anemia during PEG-IFN-α treatment for CHB; analyzes the association between cytopenias and antiviral efficacy; and proposes pretreatment risk stratification, standardized monitoring strategies, graded management protocols (including oral leukocyte-raising agents, recombinant human granulocyte colony-stimulating factor, recombinant human interleukin-11, recombinant human thrombopoietin, and other supportive therapies), as well as management recommendations for special populations, including patients with liver cirrhosis, older adults, children, and patients with renal insufficiency. It emphasizes that mild-to-moderate cytopenias should not be used as the sole reason for dose reduction or treatment discontinuation but should be assessed in conjunction with on-treatment efficacy indicators. This consensus aims to provide a reference for the standardized management of hematologic adverse reactions associated with PEG-IFN-α therapy for CHB, thereby improving treatment completion rates and patient safety. Practice guideline registration: Practice Guideline Registration for Transparency (PREPARE-2026CN2145)

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究需要解决临床医生在治疗 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 聚乙二醇化干扰素-α (PEG-IFN-α) 治疗期间血液学不良反应时面临的挑战。目的是根据当前证据和临床实践就这些不良反应的管理提供共识。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 国家感染病医学中心组织感染病学、肝病学、血液学、临床药学专家组成专家组制定本共识。该研究重点关注接受PEG-IFN-α治疗CHB的患者,包括肝硬化患者、老年人、儿童和肾功能不全患者等特殊人群。
elements_zh.methods: 该共识是通过对 PEG-IFN-α 发病率 治疗 CHB 期间中性粒细胞减少、血小板减少和贫血的临床特征和机制进行系统分析而制定的。它还评估血细胞减少症与 抗病毒药物 疗效之间的关联,并提出标准化监测策略和管理方案。
elements_zh.main_results: 它还分析了血细胞减少症与 抗病毒药物 疗效之间的关联,并提出治疗前风险分层、标准化监测策略和分级管理方案。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,轻度至中度血细胞减少不应是减少剂量或 治疗 停药的唯一原因,而应与 治疗 疗效指标一起进行评估。这为管理接受 PEG-IFN-α 治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者的血液学不良反应提供了一个新的框架。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为与 PEG-IFN-α 治疗 CHB 相关的血液学不良反应的标准化管理提供信息,从而有可能提高 治疗 的完成率和患者安全性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于专家共识而不是经验数据,这可能会限制证据的强度。然而,对当前证据和临床实践的系统分析为拟议的管理策略提供了中等程度的信心。

title: Peripheral immune landscape in hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure: Tumor necrosis factor-α, M1-like macrophages, and lymphocyte exhaustion
abstract: BACKGROUND Hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) is a critical illness with high 28-day mortality. It is associated with immunometabolic-mediated systemic inflammation leading to multi-organ failure. AIM To investigate the peripheral immune landscape in patients with HBV-ACLF, with particular attention to the associations among tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) levels, M1 macrophage polarization, and lymphocyte exhaustion. METHODS In this prospective cross-sectional study of 97 subjects (healthy controls, chronic hepatitis B, and HBV-ACLF), flow cytometry and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay quantified peripheral immune profiles and cytokines. Independent associated factors were identified via least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) and multivariable logistic regression. The Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction was applied to all intergroup comparisons and correlation analyses. RESULTS HBV-ACLF patients exhibited profound peripheral immune remodeling, featuring a pro-inflammatory shift toward M1-like monocyte/macrophage polarization accompanied by compensatory upregulation of M2-like monocytes/macrophages and a sharp escalation in serum TNF-α, interferon-gamma, and interleukin (IL)-6 ( all FDR-adjusted P < 0.05). LASSO regression with 10-fold cross-validation selected 9 feature variables, and after iterative variance inflation factor refinement, 6 variables were retained. Firth’s bias-reduced logistic regression identified elevated TNF-α as an independent associated factor [odds ratio (OR) = 1.359, 95%CI: 1.056-1.749, P = 0.017]. Notably, TNF-α and IL-6 exhibited strong collinearity (Spearman rho = 0.834); sensitivity analysis substituting IL-6 for TNF-α yielded consistent findings (IL-6: OR = 1.187, 95%CI: 1.052-1.339, P = 0.005). analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项前瞻性横断面研究,涉及 97 名受试者,包括健康对照、慢性乙型肝炎 患者和 HBV-ACLF 患者。该研究检查了这些群体的免疫特征和细胞因子水平。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用流式细胞术和酶联免疫吸附测定对外周免疫谱和细胞因子进行定量。通过 LASSO 回归和多变量逻辑回归确定独立相关因素。Benjamini-Hochberg 错误发现率 (FDR) 校正应用于所有组间比较和相关分析。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为强调了 HBV-ACLF 外周免疫环境中促炎性重塑和免疫耗竭的共存,将 TNF-α 确定为关键的免疫病理学相关因素。这项研究为 HBV-ACLF 的免疫机制提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,针对 TNF-α 并监测多谱系免疫串扰对于 HBV-ACLF 的风险分层和治疗干预可能很有价值。它们可能会为未来治疗这种疾病的研究和临床策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其横截面设计和潜在的混杂因素而受到限制。然而,证据是强有力的,FDR 调整的 P 值和敏感性分析的结果一致。

title: Hepatitis B surface antigen-targeting strategies for clearance: A review of progress from mechanistic exploration to clinical translation
abstract: Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) persistence hinders the achievement of a functional cure in patients with chronic hepatitis B. Strategies to suppress or eliminate HBsAg and break the host immune tolerance while restoring immune response become key components of immune therapy-directed clinical cure. Agents that target HBsAg include monoclonal antibodies, small interfering RNAs, antisense oligonucleotides, gene editing technologies, capsid assembly modulators, and therapeutic agents targeting secretion pathways. Immune checkpoint inhibitors and other immune-based clearance approaches are also included within this strategic framework. These agents target the HBsAg lifecycle and its source templates, including covalently closed circular DNA and integrated hepatitis B virus DNA in the host genome. This article reviews these strategies by synthesizing the latest information from preclinical studies and clinical trials, summarises their mechanisms and efficacy, discusses challenges and prospects for combinations, and aims to provide a scientific basis for chronic hepatitis B curative research.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on strategies targeting the Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) for clearance in patients with chronic hepatitis B. The central question is how to suppress or eliminate HBsAg and break host immune tolerance to restore immune response, which is essential for achieving a functional cure.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes the latest information from preclinical studies and clinical trials. It includes a range of agents targeting HBsAg, such as monoclonal antibodies, small interfering RNAs, antisense oligonucleotides, gene editing technologies, capsid assembly modulators, and therapeutic agents targeting secretion pathways. The review also incorporates immune checkpoint inhibitors and other immune-based clearance approaches within the strategic framework.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that agents targeting HBsAg and its source templates, including covalently closed circular DNA and integrated hepatitis B virus DNA in the host genome, are critical for immune therapy-directed clinical cure. analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies challenges in the development and application of these strategies, including the need for combinations to enhance efficacy. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on optimizing combinations of HBsAg-targeting agents and immune-based therapies. It also emphasizes the importance of further studies to evaluate the efficacy of these strategies across various HBV genotypes and to address the limitations in current methodologies.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores strategies targeting the Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) for the clearance of chronic hepatitis B. It highlights the importance of suppressing HBsAg and breaking host immune tolerance to restore immune response, which is crucial for achieving a functional cure. The review synthesizes preclinical and clinical data on agents such as monoclonal antibodies, small interfering RNAs, and gene editing technologies, which target HBsAg and its source templates. It also discusses the inclusion of immune checkpoint inhibitors and other immune-based approaches within the strategic framework. Despite progress, challenges remain, particularly in the development of effective combinations and the lack of long-term data. The review underscores the need for further research to optimize these strategies and evaluate their efficacy across different HBV genotypes, providing a scientific basis for curative research in chronic hepatitis B.

title: Malaria prevalence, associated factors, and coinfections with HIV, hepatitis B, and syphilis among pregnant women in Bweyale Town Council, Uganda
abstract: Malaria during pregnancy remains a major cause of preventable maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality in sub-Saharan Africa despite the availability of effective preventive interventions. Pregnant women with malaria may also have concurrent infections such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and syphilis, which can further worsen pregnancy outcomes. However, little is known about the burden of malaria, associated factors, and malaria-HIV, malaria-HBV, and malaria-syphilis coinfections among pregnant women in Bweyale Town Council, Uganda. This study determined the malaria prevalence, associated factors, and coinfections with HIV, Hepatitis B, and Syphilis among pregnant women in Bweyale Town Council, Uganda. A facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted between April and May 2026 at three health centres in Bweyale Town Council. Participants were recruited using convenience sampling. Malaria was confirmed using a pan-species rapid diagnostic test, while HIV, hepatitis B, and syphilis results were extracted from antenatal records using interviewer-administered questionnaires. Factors associated with malaria were assessed using modified Poisson regression with robust standard errors, and adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs) with 95% confidence intervals were reported. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. A total of 422 pregnant women were enrolled. The median age was 24 years (IQR: 20–27), and 95.3% (402/422) were married. The prevalence of laboratory-confirmed malaria was 12.6% (53/422; 95% CI 10.0–16.0%). HIV, HBV, and syphilis prevalence were 4.0 , 2.8 , and 2.6% , respectively. Malaria-HIV and malaria-syphilis coinfections occurred in 0.5% and 1.0% of participants, respectively. Women who did not sleep under long-lasting insecticide-treated nets (LLINs) had more than twice the prevalence of malaria compared with net users (aPR 2.45, 95% CI 1.47–4.09; p = 0.001). About one in eight pregnant women attending ANC in Bweyale Town Council had malaria infection. Malaria coinfections with HIV and syphilis were also identified. Failure to sleep under an insecticide-treated net was independently associated with malaria. Strengthening malaria preventive strategies used in ANC could contribute to reducing malaria in pregnancy and its associated adverse outcomes.

title_zh: 乌干达布韦亚勒镇议会孕妇中的疟疾 患病率、相关因素以及艾滋病毒、乙型肝炎和梅毒的合并感染
source_body_en: Malaria during pregnancy remains a major cause of preventable maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality in sub-Saharan Africa despite the availability of effective preventive interventions. Pregnant women with malaria may also have concurrent infections such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and syphilis, which can further worsen pregnancy outcomes. However, little is known about the burden of malaria, associated factors, and malaria-HIV, malaria-HBV, and malaria-syphilis coinfections among pregnant women in Bweyale Town Council, Uganda. This study determined the malaria prevalence, associated factors, and coinfections with HIV, Hepatitis B, and Syphilis among pregnant women in Bweyale Town Council, Uganda. A facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted between April and May 2026 at three health centres in Bweyale Town Council. Participants were recruited using convenience sampling. Malaria was confirmed using a pan-species rapid diagnostic test, while HIV, hepatitis B, and syphilis results were extracted from antenatal records using interviewer-administered questionnaires. Factors associated with malaria were assessed using modified Poisson regression with robust standard errors, and adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs) with 95% confidence intervals were reported. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05. A total of 422 pregnant women were enrolled. The median age was 24 years (IQR: 20–27), and 95.3% (402/422) were married. The prevalence of laboratory-confirmed malaria was 12.6% (53/422; 95% CI 10.0–16.0%). HIV, HBV, and syphilis prevalence were 4.0 , 2.8 , and 2.6% , respectively. Malaria-HIV and malaria-syphilis coinfections occurred in 0.5% and 1.0% of participants, respectively. Women who did not sleep under long-lasting insecticide-treated nets (LLINs) had more than twice the prevalence of malaria compared with net users (aPR 2.45, 95% CI 1.47–4.09; p = 0.001). About one in eight pregnant women attending ANC in Bweyale Town Council had malaria infection. Malaria coinfections with HIV and syphilis were also identified. Failure to sleep under an insecticide-treated net was independently associated with malaria. Strengthening malaria preventive strategies used in ANC could contribute to reducing malaria in pregnancy and its associated adverse outcomes.

title: Pegylated interferon α-2b add-on to nucleos(t)ide analogues reduces hepatocellular carcinoma and decompensation in advanced fibrotic chronic hepatitis B
abstract: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

title_zh: 聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2b 添加到核苷(酸)类似物可减少肝细胞癌和晚期纤维化的失代偿 慢性乙型肝炎
source_body_en: BACKGROUND The current therapeutic strategy of adding pegylated interferon (Peg-IFN) α-2b to nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) is primarily aimed at achieving functional cure. However, its value in improving prognosis and the suitable candidates for this combination strategy in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis remain to be further explored. AIM To evaluate the long-term prognosis benefit of add-on Peg-IFNα-2b therapy in patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective cohort study enrolled patients diagnosed with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or compensated cirrhosis. Participants were divided into two groups: (1) Those receiving combination therapy (Peg-IFNα-2b add-on to ongoing NA treatment); and (2) Those receiving NA monotherapy. A 1:1 propensity score matching approach was applied to balance baseline characteristics between groups. In survival analysis, the outcomes of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and decompensated cirrhosis were stratified by baseline clinical features and established HCC risk scores. RESULTS The analysis included 302 matched pairs, with a median follow-up duration of 220 weeks. Combination therapy was associated with a significantly lower risk of developing HCC (hazard ratio = 0.22; 95%CI: 0.11-0.48) and decompensated cirrhosis (hazard ratio = 0.39; 95%CI: 0.20-0.77) than NA monotherapy. These benefits were particularly pronounced among patients classified as intermediate-to-high risk by validated HCC prediction models and in those with persistent biochemical abnormalities lasting > 12 months. CONCLUSION Add-on therapy with Peg-IFNα-2b to NAs is significantly associated with reduced HCC and decompensation in high-risk patients with HBV-related advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, supporting its use in this population.

title: Perceived stigma and disclosure concerns despite family support among chronic hepatitis B patients: mixed-methods evidence from India
abstract: This mixed-methods cross-sectional study measured enacted and perceived stigma among chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in India and explored lived experiences and psychosocial challenges associated with hepatitis B diagnosis. A total of 273 participants aged ≥ 18 years with chronic hepatitis B (hepatitis B surface antigen [HBsAg]-positive) were recruited from a tertiary hospital in New Delhi during 2024. Quantitative data used structured questionnaires and an 11-item hepatitis B adaptation of the Berger HIV Stigma Scale measuring four dimensions of perceived stigma: disclosure concerns, personalized stigma, public attitudes, and negative self-image, plus four enacted stigma indicators including social exclusion, workplace discrimination, family isolation, and partner abandonment. Twenty participants underwent qualitative interviews exploring diagnosis reactions, discrimination experiences, and coping mechanisms. The mean age was 41.57 years; 60.1% were male, 72.5% married, and 58.6% held graduate or higher qualifications. Most participants disagreed with the stigma statements in each of the four domains (64.5%–82.4%); the median total score was 22 (IQR 22–28) of a possible 11–44. Enacted stigma within families was uncommon (98.53% reported no family isolation), whereas 31.14% reported hesitancy about disclosing their status. Social marginalization persisted, with 15.75% excluded and 28.57% reporting career impacts. Among women diagnosed during pregnancy (n = 68), 76.5% reported concern about mother-to-child transmission. These findings provide crucial evidence supporting the Viral Hepatitis (Prevention and Control) Bill, 2025, highlighting urgent need for anti-discrimination provisions and targeted interventions addressing workplace discrimination and pregnancy-related concerns.

title_zh: 尽管 慢性乙型肝炎 患者有家人支持,但仍感到耻辱和信息披露问题:来自印度的混合方法证据
source_body_en: This mixed-methods cross-sectional study measured enacted and perceived stigma among chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in India and explored lived experiences and psychosocial challenges associated with hepatitis B diagnosis. A total of 273 participants aged ≥ 18 years with chronic hepatitis B (hepatitis B surface antigen [HBsAg]-positive) were recruited from a tertiary hospital in New Delhi during 2024. Quantitative data used structured questionnaires and an 11-item hepatitis B adaptation of the Berger HIV Stigma Scale measuring four dimensions of perceived stigma: disclosure concerns, personalized stigma, public attitudes, and negative self-image, plus four enacted stigma indicators including social exclusion, workplace discrimination, family isolation, and partner abandonment. Twenty participants underwent qualitative interviews exploring diagnosis reactions, discrimination experiences, and coping mechanisms. The mean age was 41.57 years; 60.1% were male, 72.5% married, and 58.6% held graduate or higher qualifications. Most participants disagreed with the stigma statements in each of the four domains (64.5%–82.4%); the median total score was 22 (IQR 22–28) of a possible 11–44. Enacted stigma within families was uncommon (98.53% reported no family isolation), whereas 31.14% reported hesitancy about disclosing their status. Social marginalization persisted, with 15.75% excluded and 28.57% reporting career impacts. Among women diagnosed during pregnancy (n = 68), 76.5% reported concern about mother-to-child transmission. These findings provide crucial evidence supporting the Viral Hepatitis (Prevention and Control) Bill, 2025, highlighting urgent need for anti-discrimination provisions and targeted interventions addressing workplace discrimination and pregnancy-related concerns.

title: Anti-HDV Seropositivity and Its Association with Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Liver Disease Severity in Patients with HBV-Related Cirrhosis: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Hepatitis D virus (HDV) is an established risk factor for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); however, data comparing anti-HDV-positive and anti-HDV-negative patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related cirrhosis, particularly from endemic regions, are limited. We evaluated the association of anti-HDV seropositivity with HCC and liver disease severity in HBV-related cirrhosis. This retrospective cross-sectional study included 221 patients with HBV-related cirrhosis and available anti-HDV results (September 2020–September 2025). Clinical data were obtained at or before HCC diagnosis or liver transplantation. HCC was assessed by multivariable logistic regression, disease severity by linear regression of the log-transformed Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) score, and transplantation history by Firth’s penalized logistic regression. Anti-HDV was positive in 39 patients (18%), 14 of whom (36%) had detectable HDV RNA; 94 patients (43%) had HCC. Anti-HDV seropositivity was not associated with HCC (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 0.86; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.38–1.95). After adjustment for age and sex, MELD scores were 24% higher in anti-HDV-positive patients (geometric mean ratio 1.24; 95% CI 1.05–1.45), an association that persisted among patients without HCC. In an exploratory analysis, anti-HDV seropositivity was also associated with transplantation history (aOR 6.32; 95% CI 2.52–15.99). In HBV-related cirrhosis, anti-HDV seropositivity was associated with more severe liver disease but not with HCC.

title: Exploring the role of apolipoproteins in hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure
abstract: BACKGROUND Hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) carries high mortality, yet current prognostic tools lack molecular precision. AIM To investigate the involvement of apolipoproteins (APO) in HBV-ACLF through using proteomics analyses. METHODS We analyzed serum samples from 10 healthy controls and 20 patients with HBV-ACLF treated with a plasma exchange-centered artificial liver support system (10 survivors, 10 non-survivors) using quanititative proteomics via data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry. Differential protein expression (fold-change ≥ 1.2 or ≤ 0.833, P < 0.05) was analyzed using Gene Ontology and protein–protein interaction network tools. Clinical parameters like liver enzymes and bilirubin were assessed concurrently. RESULTS Among more than 200 differentially expressed proteins, he levels of APOL1, APOA1, APOC1, APOC2, and APOH were significantly lower in the HBV-ACLF groups than in the control groups, and the levels of APOC1, APOC2, and APOH were significantly lower in non-survivors than in survivor group. However, after adjusting for confounding factors, the differences were not statistically significant. Furthermore, the combined diagnosis panel of APOL1 and APOA1 showed the highest diagnostic accuracy for HBV-ACLF, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.940 (P = 0.0001). Similarly, the combination of APOC2 and APOH yielded the highest predictive performance for non-survival, achieving an AUC of 0.990 (P = 0.0002). The protein-protein interaction network positioned APO as hubs in lipid metabolism and inflammation pathways. CONCLUSION These APO may provide new clues for early detection and prognostic risk stratification of HBV-ACLF. Large sample studies are needed to validate our findings in the future.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to investigate the role of apolipoproteins in hepatitis B virus-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) using proteomics analyses. Serum samples from 10 healthy controls and 20 HBV-ACLF patients (10 survivors, 10 non-survivors) were analyzed with quantitative proteomics via data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry. The results showed that APOL1, APOA1, APOC1, APOC2, and APOH levels were significantly lower in HBV-ACLF groups compared to controls, with APOC1, APOC2, and APOH levels also being lower in non-survivors. The combination of APOL1 and APOA1 demonstrated the highest diagnostic accuracy for HBV-ACLF, while APOC2 and APOH showed the best predictive performance for non-survival. The authors suggest that these apolipoproteins may offer new insights for early detection and risk stratification. However, the study notes that after adjusting for confounding factors, the differences were not statistically significant, highlighting a limitation in the evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 相关的慢加急性肝衰竭 (HBV-ACLF) 具有较高的 死亡率,但目前的预后工具缺乏分子精度。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 目的通过蛋白质组学分析探讨载脂蛋白(APO)在HBV-ACLF中的参与情况。我们通过数据独立采集质谱法使用定量蛋白质组学分析了 10 名健康对照者和 20 名接受以血浆置换为中心的人工肝支持系统治疗的 HBV-ACLF 患者(10 名幸存者,10 名非幸存者)的血清样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用基因本体论和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络工具分析差异蛋白质表达(倍数变化≥1.2或≤0.833,P<0.05)。同时评估肝酶和胆红素等临床参数。

title: Early prediction of week-48 HBsAg clearance in nucleos(t)ide analogue-treated patients with chronic hepatitis B and low-level viremia receiving add-on pegylated interferon alfa-2b: a multicenter real-world study
abstract: To develop an early prediction model using LASSO regression for HBsAg clearance at week 48 in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients with low-level viremia (LLV) receiving nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) combined with pegylated interferon alpha-2b (Peg-IFNα-2b), and to evaluate its predictive performance. We retrospectively analyzed a multicenter prospective cohort of 327 patients with chronic hepatitis B and low-level viremia who initiated nucleos(t)ide analogue plus Peg-IFNα-2b therapy. Predictors with P < 0.20 in univariable analyses, together with age and sex, were considered for LASSO selection. The retained predictors were used to develop a nomogram in 310 patients with observed week-48 outcomes. The model underwent bootstrap internal validation (1,000 resamples), external validation in 158 patients using the original coefficients, and non-responder imputation (NRI) sensitivity analysis in 325 patients with available week-12 predictors. Exploratory analyses assessed model discrimination by baseline HBeAg status without refitting; a separate HBeAg-positive model was not developed because of the limited number of clearance events. Among 310 patients with observed week-48 outcomes, 47 achieved HBsAg clearance. The final model included baseline HBsAg and its decline by week 12, both were associated with clearance (OR = 0.26, 95% CI: 0.18–0.38 and OR = 5.72, 95% CI: 3.15–10.38). The apparent AUC was 0.889 (95% CI: 0.818–0.961), with favorable bootstrap validation, calibration, and decision curve results. The AUCs for week-12 HBsAg alone and the week-12 HBsAg < 100 IU/mL threshold were 0.886 and 0.870, respectively, indicating discrimination comparable to that of the final model. In the external validation cohort ( n = 158), the AUC was 0.845 (95% CI: 0.753–0.937). The NRI sensitivity analysis yielded a similar AUC of 0.887 (95% CI: 0.815–0.959) among 325 patients with week-12 predictor data. Based on LASSO regression, we developed a nomogram integrating baseline HBsAg level and its decline from baseline to week 12 to estimate week-48 HBsAg clearance in patients with CHB and low-level viremia receiving combined NAs and Peg-IFNα-2b therapy. The model showed good predictive performance and may provide a useful reference for clinical risk assessment, although its discrimination was comparable to that of simpler week-12 HBsAg measures.

title_zh: 接受附加聚乙二醇干扰素 alfa-2b 的核苷(酸)类似物治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 和低水平病毒血症患者的第 48 周 HBsAg 清除率的早期预测:一项多中心真实世界研究
source_body_en: To develop an early prediction model using LASSO regression for HBsAg clearance at week 48 in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients with low-level viremia (LLV) receiving nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs) combined with pegylated interferon alpha-2b (Peg-IFNα-2b), and to evaluate its predictive performance. We retrospectively analyzed a multicenter prospective cohort of 327 patients with chronic hepatitis B and low-level viremia who initiated nucleos(t)ide analogue plus Peg-IFNα-2b therapy. Predictors with P < 0.20 in univariable analyses, together with age and sex, were considered for LASSO selection. The retained predictors were used to develop a nomogram in 310 patients with observed week-48 outcomes. The model underwent bootstrap internal validation (1,000 resamples), external validation in 158 patients using the original coefficients, and non-responder imputation (NRI) sensitivity analysis in 325 patients with available week-12 predictors. Exploratory analyses assessed model discrimination by baseline HBeAg status without refitting; a separate HBeAg-positive model was not developed because of the limited number of clearance events. Among 310 patients with observed week-48 outcomes, 47 achieved HBsAg clearance. The final model included baseline HBsAg and its decline by week 12, both were associated with clearance (OR = 0.26, 95% CI: 0.18–0.38 and OR = 5.72, 95% CI: 3.15–10.38). The apparent AUC was 0.889 (95% CI: 0.818–0.961), with favorable bootstrap validation, calibration, and decision curve results. The AUCs for week-12 HBsAg alone and the week-12 HBsAg < 100 IU/mL threshold were 0.886 and 0.870, respectively, indicating discrimination comparable to that of the final model. In the external validation cohort ( n = 158), the AUC was 0.845 (95% CI: 0.753–0.937). The NRI sensitivity analysis yielded a similar AUC of 0.887 (95% CI: 0.815–0.959) among 325 patients with week-12 predictor data. Based on LASSO regression, we developed a nomogram integrating baseline HBsAg level and its decline from baseline to week 12 to estimate week-48 HBsAg clearance in patients with CHB and low-level viremia receiving combined NAs and Peg-IFNα-2b therapy. The model showed good predictive performance and may provide a useful reference for clinical risk assessment, although its discrimination was comparable to that of simpler week-12 HBsAg measures.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在为接受核苷(酸)类似物加 Peg-IFNα-2b 治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 和低水平病毒血症患者开发第 48 周 HBsAg 清除的早期预测模型。

title: Hepatitis B virus reactivation across immunocompromised populations: a hybrid umbrella review and de novo meta-analysis — an evidence map by serological status and immunosuppressive exposure
abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus reactivation is a preventable but inconsistently managed complication of immunosuppressive therapy. Although antiviral prophylaxis is widely recommended for HBsAg+ individuals, the certainty and applicability of evidence across resolved HBV infection, emerging immunotherapies, biologics, transplantation, and regional settings remain unclear. Aim We aimed to synthesize meta-analytic evidence on HBVr in immunocompromised populations and to map the certainty of evidence according to HBV serological status and immunosuppressive exposure. Methods This study employed a two-level analytical framework. The first level involved review-level synthesis: a systematic search was conducted for systematic reviews and meta-analyses published in six databases between January 2014 and March 2025; methodological quality was assessed using the AMSTAR‐2 tool; and the degree of overlap among reviews was quantified using the Corrected Covered Area. The second level involved a de novo meta-analysis of primary studies: data from duplicate-free primary studies were extracted from the search results, and a random-effects model was used to calculate pooled incidence estimates. Evidence maps were created for the results of both levels, stratified by serological status and immunosuppressive exposure. Results This study included a total of 10 systematic reviews/meta-analyses, covering 275 original studies after deduplication. At the review level, the methodological quality of the included reviews was low or very low. A narrative synthesis showed that the risk of HBVr was highest among HBsAg+ individuals, followed by HBsAg-/anti-HBc+ individuals. The de novo meta-analysis of primary studies further quantified these risks: the pooled incidence of HBVr in HBsAg+ individuals was 11.44% (95% CI:​9.17%–13.86%), whilst that in HBsAg-/anti-HBc+ individuals was 0.99% (95% CI:​0.41%–1.74%); estimates for the anti-HBs- subgroup were higher than those for the anti-HBs+ subgroup. However, significant heterogeneity was observed across all subgroup analyses; these overall estimates should therefore be regarded as broad summaries derived from a highly heterogeneous evidence base, rather than precise incidence rates directly extrapolatable to clinical practice. Prophylactic antiviral therapy is associated with a lower incidence of HBVr in HBsAg+ individuals; however, evidence of benefit in patients with resolved HBV infection and head-to-head evidence comparing different antiviral drugs remains insufficient. Conclusion Evidence supports risk-based prophylaxis in HBsAg+ patients, but uncertainties persist for resolved HBV infection, biologic/ICI therapies, and transplantation. This evidence map may inform guideline updates and future research.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 乙型肝炎病毒 再激活是免疫抑制治疗的一种可预防但管理不一致的并发症。尽管广泛建议对 HBsAg+ 个体进行 抗病毒药物 预防,但在解决 HBV 感染、新兴免疫疗法、生物制剂、移植和区域环境方面证据的确定性和适用性仍不清楚。目的 我们旨在综合免疫功能低下人群中 HBVr 的荟萃分析证据,并根据 HBV 血清学状态和免疫抑制暴露绘制证据的确定性。方法本研究采用了两级分析框架。第一级涉及综述级综合:对2014年1月至2025年3月期间在六个数据库中发表的系统综述和荟萃分析进行系统检索;使用 AMSTAR-2 工具评估方法学质量;评论之间的重叠程度使用修正覆盖面积进行量化。第二级涉及对初级研究进行从头荟萃分析:从搜索结果中提取来自无重复初级研究的数据,并使用随机效应模型来计算汇总的 发病率 估计值。针对两个水平的结果创建了证据图,并按血清学状态和免疫抑制暴露进行分层。结果本研究共纳入10项系统评价/荟萃分析,涵盖重复数据删除后的275项原始研究。在综述层面,纳入综述的方法学质量较低或非常低。综合叙述表明,HBsAg+ 个体中 HBVr 的风险最高,其次是 HBsAg-/抗 HBc+ 个体。初步研究的从头荟萃分析进一步量化了这些风险:HBsAg+ 个体中 HBVr 的汇总 发病率 为 11.44%(95% CI:9.17%–13.86%),而 HBsAg-/抗 HBc+ 个体中的 发病率 为 0.99%(95% CI:0.41%–1.74%);抗 HBs- 亚组的估计值高于抗 HBs+ 亚组的估计值。然而,所有亚组分析均观察到显着的异质性;因此,这些总体估计值应被视为源自高度异质性证据基础的广泛总结,而不是可直接外推至临床实践的精确 发病率 率。预防性 发病率 治疗与 HBsAg+ 个体中 HBVr 较低的 发病率 相关;然而,对于乙肝病毒感染已治愈的患者的获益证据以及比较不同 抗病毒药物 药物的头对头证据仍然不足。结论 证据支持 HBsAg+ 患者基于风险的预防,但解决 HBV 感染、生物/ICI 治疗和移植仍存在不确定性。该证据图可以为指南更新和未来的研究提供信息。

title: Comparison of Non-Invasive Markers with Liver Biopsy for Detecting Fibrosis in Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: Objectives Liver biopsy is the gold standard for determining liver fibrosis in chronic hepatitis B (CHB); however, alternative methods, such as non-invasive indirect serum markers, are being developed because it is an invasive procedure. This study aimed to compare fibrosis values from liver biopsies of patients with CHB to non-invasive serum markers to determine the efficacy of these markers. Materials and Methods Patients with a diagnosis of CHB who underwent a liver biopsy were retrospectively included. According to the Ishak fibrosis staging system, patients were divided into two groups: mild fibrosis (F0-2) and advanced fibrosis (F3-6). Age-platelet index, aspartate aminotransferase (AST)-to-platelet ratio index (APRI), AST/alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ratio (AAR), fibrosis-4 index, Fibro-Q, and King’s score were calculated. The markers were compared with respect to their ability to distinguish advanced fibrosis. Results A total of 183 patients were included. Of these, mild fibrosis (≤2) was detected in 101 patients and advanced fibrosis (>2) in 82. At the beginning of treatment, ALT, AST, the histological activity index, and HBV-DNA levels were significantly higher in the advanced fibrosis group (p<0.05). APRI, King’s score, and AAR (inversely) were statistically significant for detecting advanced fibrosis (p<0.05). The area under the receiver operating characteristic values for APRI, AAR, and King’s score were 0.611, 0.637, and 0.632, respectively. Conclusion APRI and King’s scores were statistically significant in differentiating advanced from mild fibrosis, but their efficacy was limited. AAR, displaying an inverse relationship, likely reflected inflammatory activity rather than actual fibrosis. Liver biopsy appears to be the gold standard for diagnosing fibrosis in patients with CHB. New studies are needed to develop non-invasive markers.

abstract_zh: 目的 肝活检是确定 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 肝纤维化的金标准;然而,正在开发替代方法,例如非侵入性间接血清标记物,因为它是一种侵入性程序。本研究旨在将慢性乙型肝炎患者肝活检的纤维化值与非侵入性血清标志物进行比较,以确定这些标志物的功效。材料和方法 回顾性纳入接受肝活检的 诊断 慢性乙型肝炎患者。根据Ishak纤维化分期系统,将患者分为两组:轻度纤维化(F0-2)和晚期纤维化(F3-6)。计算年龄-血小板指数、天冬氨酸转氨酶(AST)与血小板比值指数(APRI)、AST/丙氨酸转氨酶(ALT)比值(AAR)、纤维化-4指数、Fibro-Q和King’s评分。比较了标记物区分晚期纤维化的能力。结果共纳入183例患者。其中,101例患者检测到轻度纤维化(≤2),82例检测到晚期纤维化(>2)。在治疗治疗开始时,晚期纤维化组的ALT、AST、组织学活动指数和HBV-DNA水平显着升高(p<0.05)。APRI、King’s 评分和 AAR(反比)对于检测晚期纤维化具有统计学意义 (p<0.05)。APRI、AAR 和 King’s 评分的接受者操作特征值下面积分别为 0.611、0.637 和 0.632。结论 APRI 和 King’s 评分在区分晚期和轻度纤维化方面具有统计学意义,但其功效有限。AAR 显示出反比关系,可能反映了炎症活动而不是实际的纤维化。肝活检似乎是诊断慢性乙型肝炎患者纤维化的金标准。需要新的研究来开发非侵入性标记物。

analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用了血清标志物,包括年龄-血小板指数、APRI、AAR、纤维化-4指数、Fibro-Q和King’s评分,并将它们与肝活检结果进行比较。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总共纳入 183 名患者,其中轻度纤维化组 101 名,晚期纤维化组 82 名。APRI、AAR 和 King’s 评分在检测晚期纤维化方面显示出统计学显着性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: APRI 和 King’s 评分在区分晚期纤维化和轻度纤维化方面具有统计学意义,但其功效有限。AAR 可能反映了炎症活动而不是实际的纤维化。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 肝活检仍然是诊断慢性乙型肝炎纤维化的金标准,需要新的研究来开发更有效的非侵入性标志物。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的回顾性设计和有限的样本量可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。标记物的功效有限,需要进一步研究。

title: Clonorchis sinensis co-infection potentiates polymorphonuclear-myeloid-derived suppressor cells expansion and metabolic reprogramming in chronic hepatitis B patients
abstract: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

title_zh: 华支睾吸虫共感染增强 慢性乙型肝炎 患者多形核骨髓源性抑制细胞的扩增和代谢重编程
source_body_en: BACKGROUND Clonorchis sinensis (C. sinensis ) co-infection is known to accelerate disease progression and induce immune tolerance in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV), particularly in regions where both infections are endemic. Metabolic reprogramming has emerged as a key driver of immunosuppression. These metabolic shifts are often orchestrated by myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs), which expand during chronic infections to promote immune tolerance. sinensis co-infection reprograms metabolism to favor MDSC-linked suppression and how this process relates to normal liver enzyme levels remains unclear. AIM To investigate whether C. sinensis co-infection induces MDSC- linked metabolic reprogramming in patients with HBV and normal liver enzyme levels. METHODS In this cross-sectional study, a total of 117 participants were enrolled and assigned to four groups: Healthy controls (n = 30), C. sinensis mono-infected participants (n = 29), HBV mono-infected participants (n = 28), and co-infected participants (n = 30). Serum cytokine profiles were measured using chemiluminescence immunoassay, amino acid metabolites using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, and MDSC subsets using flow cytometry. Spearman correlation and mediation analyses were performed to explore the relationships among inflammation, metabolism, and immunity. RESULTS HBV mono-infected and co-infected patients showed no statistically significant differences in liver enzyme and HBV DNA levels. However, compared with the HBV mono-infected group, the co-infected group had higher levels of the inflammatory cytokine: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) and tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), accompanied by markedly lower interferon-γ (IFN-γ) levels. Flow cytometric assay revealed that polymorphonuclear MDSCs (PMN-MDSCs) showed the greatest expansion in the co-infected group, and their proportion correlated strongly with IL-6 and TNF-α levels. Metabolically, the co-infected group had a significantly higher ornithine-to-arginine ratio. Mediation analysis suggested that PMN-MDSCs accounted for approximately 45% of the total effect of IL-6 on IFN-γ suppression. sinensis co-infection was associated with immunosuppression through IL-6/TNF-α-linked PMN-MDSC expansion and elevated ornithine-to-arginine ratio, resulting in suppressed IFN-γ production despite normal liver enzyme levels.

title: Integrated recombinase-aided amplification–invader system: a closed-tube visual platform for hepatitis B virus detection
abstract: Background Rapid and accurate hepatitis B virus (HBV) detection is essential for the early management of HBV infection. Quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR) depends on sophisticated thermal cycling instruments, which greatly restricts its application in point-of-care testing (POCT). Methods Herein, this study developed an Integrated Recombinase-Aided Amplification–invader System (IRIS) for visual and sensitive HBV DNA detection. By adapting the integrated amplification-invader strategy to RAA and optimizing the FEN1 enzyme dosage, we achieved improved reaction compatibility while effectively reducing the overall time cost. Fluorescent signals excited at 490 nm are observable by naked eye and recordable via smartphone imaging with a 520 nm filter, removing reliance on customized detection devices. Results IRIS exhibited favorable specificity and a detection limit of 10 copies per reaction. Furthermore, testing of clinical HBV specimens revealed full diagnostic concordance with commercial qPCR assays. Conclusion This simplified, equipment-independent detection method provides a feasible POCT solution for on-site HBV detection in resource-limited settings.
journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

title: Fentanyl, Heroin, and Tetrahydrocannabinol Alter Hepatitis B Virus Antigen Production, NTCP Expression, and Hepatocyte Transcriptional Profiles
abstract: Background/Objectives: Substance use may influence hepatitis B virus (HBV) pathogenesis through effects on hepatocytes that extend beyond transmission risk. This study examined how fentanyl, heroin, and tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) affect HBV surface antigen levels and host cellular responses in vitro. Methods: HBV-producing HepG2.2.15 cells and primary human hepatocytes (PHHs) were exposed to fentanyl, heroin, or THC. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and sodium taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide (NTCP) protein levels were measured by ELISA, and SLC10A1 mRNA expression was quantified by RT-qPCR. Cell-associated caspase-cleaved cytokeratin-18 was measured using the M30 CytoDeath ELISA. Host gene and microRNA expression were profiled by RNA sequencing and microRNA sequencing, respectively. Results: All three drugs increased HBsAg and NTCP protein levels in HepG2.2.15 cells. In PHHs, all three drugs increased NTCP protein abundance, and fentanyl and THC significantly increased SLC10A1 mRNA expression. M30 signals did not differ significantly across treatment conditions. Fentanyl exposure was associated with the largest number of differentially expressed genes, whereas THC exposure was associated with the largest number of microRNAs meeting the exploratory significance threshold. Conclusions: Fentanyl, heroin, and THC increased HBsAg levels in HBV-producing cells and NTCP protein abundance in both hepatocyte models. The drugs differed in their effects on host gene and microRNA expression. Further studies are needed to determine whether these changes affect HBV entry, replication, or productive infection.

title_zh: 芬太尼、海洛因和四氢大麻酚改变 乙型肝炎病毒 抗原产生、NTCP 表达和肝细胞转录谱
source_body_en: Background/Objectives: Substance use may influence hepatitis B virus (HBV) pathogenesis through effects on hepatocytes that extend beyond transmission risk. This study examined how fentanyl, heroin, and tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) affect HBV surface antigen levels and host cellular responses in vitro. Methods: HBV-producing HepG2.2.15 cells and primary human hepatocytes (PHHs) were exposed to fentanyl, heroin, or THC. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and sodium taurocholate cotransporting polypeptide (NTCP) protein levels were measured by ELISA, and SLC10A1 mRNA expression was quantified by RT-qPCR. Cell-associated caspase-cleaved cytokeratin-18 was measured using the M30 CytoDeath ELISA. Host gene and microRNA expression were profiled by RNA sequencing and microRNA sequencing, respectively. Results: All three drugs increased HBsAg and NTCP protein levels in HepG2.2.15 cells. In PHHs, all three drugs increased NTCP protein abundance, and fentanyl and THC significantly increased SLC10A1 mRNA expression. M30 signals did not differ significantly across treatment conditions. Fentanyl exposure was associated with the largest number of differentially expressed genes, whereas THC exposure was associated with the largest number of microRNAs meeting the exploratory significance threshold. Conclusions: Fentanyl, heroin, and THC increased HBsAg levels in HBV-producing cells and NTCP protein abundance in both hepatocyte models. The drugs differed in their effects on host gene and microRNA expression. Further studies are needed to determine whether these changes affect HBV entry, replication, or productive infection.
abstract_zh: 背景/目标:物质使用可能通过对肝细胞的影响而影响 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 发病机制,其影响超出了 传播 风险。本研究探讨了芬太尼、海洛因和四氢大麻酚 (THC) 如何影响体外 HBV 表面抗原水平和 宿主 细胞反应。方法:将产生 HBV 的 HepG2.2.15 细胞和原代人肝细胞 (PHH) 暴露于芬太尼、海洛因或 THC。通过 ELISA 测定乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 和牛磺胆酸钠共转运多肽 (NTCP) 蛋白水平,并通过 RT-qPCR 定量 SLC10A1 mRNA 表达。使用 M30 CytoDeath ELISA 测量细胞相关的 caspase 裂解的 cytokeratin-18。分别通过RNA测序和microRNA测序来分析宿主基因和microRNA表达。结果:所有三种药物均增加了 HepG2.2.15 细胞中的 HBsAg 和 NTCP 蛋白水平。在 PHH 中,所有三种药物均增加了 NTCP 蛋白丰度,芬太尼和 THC 显着增加了 SLC10A1 mRNA 表达。M30 信号在 治疗 条件下没有显着差异。芬太尼暴露与最大数量的差异表达基因相关,而 THC 暴露与最大数量的满足探索性显着性阈值的 microRNA 相关。结论:芬太尼、海洛因和 THC 增加了 HBV 产生细胞中的 HBsAg 水平以及两种肝细胞模型中的 NTCP 蛋白丰度。这些药物对 宿主 基因和 microRNA 表达的影响不同。需要进一步的研究来确定这些变化是否影响乙肝病毒的进入、复制或生产性感染。

title: Hepatitis B Knowledge, Seroprotection Status, and HBsAg Prevalence among Middle School Students in Saint-Louis, Senegal: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Introduction: Despite the availability of an effective vaccine, viral hepatitis B (VHB) is a major public health problem in Senegal. Aim: The objective of this study was to assess the post-vaccination immunisation status and the level of knowledge about VHB among middle school students in Saint-Louis, Senegal. Materials and Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional, descriptive and analytical study among middle school students in Saint-Louis from 5 to 25 June 2024, following the free and informed consent of their parents or legal guardians. Data were collected using a Google Forms questionnaire. Blood samples were analysed for hepatitis B virus serology using the ONE STEP HBsAg TEST to detect HBsAg and the MAGLUMI 800 system to detect anti-HBs antibodies. Middle school students with an anti-HBs antibody level ≥10 IU/L were considered to be seroprotected against VHB. Results: During the study period, 280 students were included. Only 11 students (4%) reported having heard of VHB. Two students (0.7%) knew that the causative agent is a virus. None of the students reported knowing that they had been vaccinated against VHB. Nearly all students (99.6%) did not provide any answer about the modes of VHB transmission. They reported no knowledge of the clinical signs, complications or preventive measures of VHB. The HBsAg test was negative in all middle school students. The mean anti-HBs antibody level was 21.2 IU/L (±73.2). An anti-HBs antibody level ≥10 IU/L was found in 72 middle school students, representing a seroprotection rate of 25.7%. Conclusion: Our results suggest that knowledge of VHB among middle school students in Saint-Louis was very limited. No HBsAg-positive students were identified. Slightly more than one-quarter had anti-HBs antibody levels meeting the seroprotection threshold.
journal: Asian Journal of Research in Infectious Diseases

Materials and Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional, descriptive and analytical study among middle school students in Saint-Louis from 5 to 25 June 2024, following the free and informed consent of their parents or legal guardians. Data were collected using a Google Forms questionnaire. Blood samples were analysed for hepatitis B virus serology using the ONE STEP HBsAg TEST to detect HBsAg and the MAGLUMI 800 system to detect anti-HBs antibodies. Middle school students with an anti-HBs antibody level ≥10 IU/L were considered to be seroprotected against VHB. Results: During the study period, 280 students were included. Only 11 students (4%) reported having heard of VHB. Two students (0.7%) knew that the causative agent is a virus. None of the students reported knowing that they had been vaccinated against VHB. Nearly all students (99.6%) did not provide any answer about the modes of VHB transmission. They reported no knowledge of the clinical signs, complications or preventive measures of VHB. The HBsAg test was negative in all middle school students. The mean anti-HBs antibody level was 21.2 IU/L (±73.2). An anti-HBs antibody level ≥10 IU/L was found in 72 middle school students, representing a seroprotection rate of 25.7%. Conclusion: Our results suggest that knowledge of VHB among middle school students in Saint-Louis was very limited. No HBsAg-positive students were identified. Slightly more than one-quarter had anti-HBs antibody levels meeting the seroprotection threshold.
